$comment: Placeholder imagery for the travel blog, keyed by article slug.
These are stock photographs from Unsplash, served from their CDN. They
are here so the blog can be designed and reviewed with pictures in it —
a layout first seen with real imagery is a layout nobody has looked at.
Swap the urls for commissioned or licensed files under public/images and
Every alt was written after looking at the frame. Nothing here claims the
photograph was taken by us, on one of our trips, or at a place we sell —
it describes what is in the picture and stops there.
A slug with no entry renders without an image rather than falling back to

images.alt: An aircraft wing seen from a cabin window, above a bank of cloud lit gold by a low sun.
A four-engine widebody airliner on the taxiway in front of a long terminal building.
A resort pool deck at dusk, timber sun loungers along one edge and a shingled lodge behind.
A driver's hand on the steering wheel of a car at dusk, city lights blurred through the windscreen.
An aerial view of five cruise ships berthed along a pier, turquoise water and a town either side.
A paper road map spread flat with a notebook, pencil, camera, folded maps and a small backpack on it.
